artifactClass.requiredOutputFormat: JSON plus PNG/JPG raster review evidence.
artifactClass.svgStatus: SVG disallowed for primary evidence in this task; the board uses raster inputs and rendered text/status layout only.

generationRules.sourceImageRule: Use existing Batu-supplied review/reference imagery and MVP-29E raster baseline as evidence only; no texture extraction, tracing, scraping, or production reuse.
generationRules.blockedClaimsRule: Do not convert blocked geometry, facade, frontage, address, active-status, station, or production claims into exact visual assertions.
generationRules.appRule: This artifact does not edit app source, app fixtures, package tooling, public interfaces, or normal-mode behavior.

scenePrompt: Create one review-only four-corner isometric raster scene for Manhattan Ave x Greenpoint Ave using the accepted Phase 2DTR-2 structured fixture.
Place the four storefront targets in fixed corner order: NW Grillpoint Deli, NE McDonald's, SW Dunkin', SE Citizens Bank.
Include Greenpoint G subway as symbolic station-area context only; do not imply exact entrance geometry or exact station coordinate placement.
Preserve the approved Inked Indie / Compact Corner visual language and compare against MVP-29E for storefront recognizability, cue density, and card-readiness.

Use sourced business identity/category/address text only as review context; treat facade layout, bay geometry, sign placement, entrances, and windows as manual_draft or symbolic unless specifically sourced.

Do not include ratings, reviews, hours, promotions, endorsement, partnership, service availability, production trademark clearance, exact trade-dress reproduction, tracing, texture extraction, or production/public readiness claims.
